source.source_text: Purpose: return bounded Git diff for explicit paths/ranges. Input: project_root:string, paths?:string[], staged?:boolean, base?:string, max_bytes?:1..1048576. Output: sanitized diff plus truncation/hash metadata. Contract: L2 read_only; scope mac.git.read; target project_root; timeout 15000ms; cap 1MiB; network none; filesystem read_allowed_project; secret-pattern redaction mandatory; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 3 planned.
